title: Link
description: One URL of a personMessage, with a label, so a client that renders Markdown can show [label](url). Every personMessage that holds a URL has a links array next to it: one entry per URL, in order, each url byte for byte the URL in personMessage. See CONTRACT.md, Showing links.

label.description: What opening the link does, in plain text (Approve the held write). No URL, no control character (C0, DEL, C1), no line break, no bidirectional control, no Markdown characters.

url.description: The URL exactly as it stands on its own line in personMessage: https, or http for a loopback host (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]), with only RFC 3986 characters (bytes 0x21 to 0x7E), so the CLI can print it as an OSC 8 hyperlink (CONTRACT.md, Terminal hyperlinks).
